battery_screen.c:95-105 spread = (hi - lo) × 1000, so it carries two readings' errors; :41 SCALE_FLOOR_MV 12.0f; :46 SPREAD_WATCH_MV 30.0f. 2 × 6 mV = 12 mV, the floor. Research.md:567 V7 answer: '0 to 50 °C ambient, one range for the whole IO board (owner, 2026-09-28)'.

programmer_screen.c 'Low voltage cut', 'Per cell, where it starts pulling power back to save the pack', lo 28, hi 38, decimals 1, unit V (:139-141, :166-168, :202-204). The struct comment at :75 says 'in tenths if decimals is 1'. The lowest setting is 2.8 V a cell.
IOBoard.md:431 'the coprocessor samples the bench numbers every 20 ms (50 Hz)'. main.c:1011-1016: '(uint32_t)(now - last_sample) >= 20u' then sample().

The cited lines and the arithmetic are correct. SET_OUT_RAMP is 5 to 300 %/s (settings.c:61-63), published by publish_throttle_ramp (panel main.c:94-99). The Internal R default is 18 mΩ for the whole pack (settings.c:45-47; the value cites :44-46). The Cells default is 6 (settings.c:38-40). F2 is 150 A continuous. 1 mV / 3 mΩ = 0.333 A, and 0.333 A / 450 A/s = 741 µs. 18/16 mΩ at 900 A/s gives 988 µs, and 6 cells at 900 A/s gives 370 µs. The value states the rule 'the smaller figure holds'. It then sets 370 µs aside because 'No source pairs a 6-cell pack with 300 A'. No source pairs the 6-cell default with the 150 A onboard path either. No source pairs the 18 mΩ whole-pack default with a 16-cell pack, which the 988 µs case uses. The pack settings apply to whichever path carries the current: IOBoard.md:66 gives the external-shunt input for currents above 150 A, and V35 in T2 found 300 A. By the value's own rule, the derived limit is 370 µs, not 741 µs. P2's report 'skew limit on the external path' states the shortlisted parts' 711 µs does not meet 370 µs.

figures.evidence: The derivation is the same as V186 and has the same gap. At 450 A/s (300 %/s of 150 A), 741 µs moves a 3 mΩ cell by 1 mV, and that part is arithmetically right. On the external path's 300 A (V35 found in T2), 900 A/s and the same 6-cell 18 mΩ default pack give 370 µs. No source ties that default pack to the onboard path alone (settings.c:38-47 hold one set of pack settings; IOBoard.md:66 takes currents above 150 A on the external shunt). The binding figure from these sources is 370 µs.

figures.evidence: LTC6813-1 Rev. B, 'Using the LTC6813-1 with Fewer than 18 Cells': 'all unused C inputs either shorted to the highest connected cell or left open'. The datasheet states no minimum cell count. Electrical characteristics: V+ Supply Voltage, TME Specifications Met, 16 min, 60 typ, 90 max V; V+ to C18 at least -0.3 V; C13 at least 2.5 V; C7 at least 1 V. Page 1 says it 'can be powered directly from the battery stack or from an isolated supply'.

ADBMS1818 Rev. B Table 3: V+ 16 to 90 V for TME; V+ to C18 at least -0.3 V; V+ current in MEASURE 0.95 mA typical, 1.4 mA maximum over temperature. 3 × 4.2 = 12.6 V and 4 × 4.2 = 16.8 V, so 1 to 3 cells need the supply. 5 × 2.8 = 14.0 V and 6 × 2.8 = 16.8 V, so 1 to 5 cells need it at the 2.8 V floor.

Table 3: VREG in MEASURE 15 mA typical, 16.5 mA maximum over temperature; VREG in SLEEP 3.1 µA typical. isoSPI adds 1.0 mA minimum (ISOMD 0, 20 kΩ, ready) to 10.5 mA maximum (ISOMD 1, 2 kΩ, active). V+ in MEASURE 0.95 mA typical, 1.4 mA maximum; V+ in SLEEP with VREG 0 V 6.1 µA typical, 18 µA maximum. Table 14 pin 49: DRIVE drives an NPN base with its collector to V+ and emitter to VREG. VREG supply 4.5 to 5.5 V.

Table 14: pins 53, 54, 61 and 62 are SDI, SDO, CSB and SCK in 4-wire SPI with ISOMD tied to V-, or 2-wire isoSPI with ISOMD tied to VREG. SDO is open drain and needs a 5 kΩ pull-up. Table 15 lists the port pins. The part has no I²C target port: GPIO3 to GPIO5 act only as an I²C or SPI controller. The jlcparts copy of 2026-09-14 has LTC6820HMS#3ZZTRPBF, C514444, stock 2912, and LTC6820IMS#TRPBF, C581009, stock 2544.
